_comment: Stage-1 FMCW radar console (server.py). One TX horn, one RX horn: the radar measures RANGE and RADIAL VELOCITY only. There is no azimuth in stage 1, so there is no bearing key and no azimuth sigma anywhere.

_meaning.radar_sigma_r: range measurement sigma (m) at snr_ref_db, from the sub-bin parabola fit in cfar_detect; inflated as 1/sqrt(SNR) below that
_meaning.radar_sigma_v: radial velocity measurement sigma (m/s) at snr_ref_db, from the Doppler bin interpolation
_meaning.sigma_a: Kalman process noise: white-noise acceleration drive (m/s^2) on the range/velocity state
_meaning.track_gate_sigma: chi-square gate on the 2-D (range, velocity) innovation; a detection further out than this is clutter, not this target
_meaning.waterfall_seconds: how much range-vs-time history the server keeps in its rolling buffer
_meaning.stale_s: no block for this long -> the console shows NO SYNC
_meaning.chirp_jitter_warn_pct: peak-to-peak spread of the SYNC-measured chirp time, as a percentage of the mean, above which the sync divider is flagged marginal
